fusions.name: Clean Cut
fusions.desc: Flicks a sheet that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Page Gust
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of wind ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Folded Ward
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dog-Eared
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
